data.one_liner: Create and display customizable context menus with hierarchical submenus in Flutter apps.
data.what_it_does: Provides a flexible context menu system for Flutter supporting custom entries, submenus, keyboard shortcuts, and multiple platforms. Menus can be displayed programmatically or via a ContextMenuRegion responding to right-clicks and long-presses.
use_when: You need custom context menus or right-click menus in your cross-platform application.
You want hierarchical submenus with selection handling and keyboard shortcuts.
avoid_when: You only need standard platform-native context menus without custom Flutter widget hierarchies.
strengths: Supports nested submenus, menu headers, and dividers.
Cross-platform compatibility across Android, iOS, Web, Windows, macOS, and Linux.
Strong typing generics upgrade for context menu entries and values.
weaknesses: Documentation for full customization is limited beyond basic examples.
